name: An Old Colleague
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a powerful device and the means to fuel it. The gnome engineer sends you across the sea to Ironforge, where his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip can make a hazardous explosive compound called Nitromirglyceronium.

sections.title: A Volatile Recipe
sections.body: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle plans his most ambitious engineering work yet. A mechanism of that scale needs fuel stronger than ordinary gunpowder or crude oil. He needs Nitromirglyceronium, also called NG-5, an explosive mix potent enough to ensure destruction if all goes according to plan.

sections.title: Tinker Town Connection
sections.body: Only one person Gaxim knows can refine NG-5: his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip. Lomac lives far to the east, in Tinker Town, the gnome quarter deep inside Ironforge. You make the long journey as Gaxim's courier, but Lomac greets you with immediate suspicion and paranoid questions.

faq.q: Who gives the quest An Old Colleague?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer in the Stonetalon Mountains, sends you to Ironforge.

faq.q: Where can I find Lomac Gearstrip?
faq.answer: Lomac Gearstrip lives in Tinker Town, the gnome quarter in the eastern part of Ironforge.
Nitromirglyceronium, or NG-5, is an extremely volatile chemical explosive that Lomac Gearstrip can make and Gaxim Rustfizzle wants for his powerful devices.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim send me all the way to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Gaxim says Lomac Gearstrip is the only person who can make the specialized NG-5 compound his experimental device needs for fuel.

faq.q: What happens after finding Lomac Gearstrip?
aliases: what comes after an old colleague
faq.answer: After you confirm Gaxim's request, the suspicious Lomac gives you Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun, which calls for hazardous reagents to mix the batch.

faq.q: Which faction can undertake this task?
faq.answer: Only Alliance adventurers can take on this work. It begins with the Alliance gnome Gaxim in Stonetalon and leads to the Alliance capital of Ironforge.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you travel across a continent from Kalimdor's embattled crags to the safety of Ironforge.
As a gnome, you know the long reach of scholarly connections, eccentric rivalries, and explosive compounds that can turn dangerously unstable.
As an engineer, you can appreciate Gaxim and Lomac's drive for maximum firepower, despite the hazardous logistics.
